mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the response routes to the body was most worthwhile: the turning eyes and posture adjustments showed what the sensors actually help accomplish.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the weighted sensors was less clear: I needed a compatibility check to discover they joined the turning-sensor assembly rather than a separate nerve item.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the weighted sensors joined the turning-sensor assembly after the balance nerves had been consumed.

arbitrary.text: The required order for connecting the response routes felt a little arbitrary. I expected to connect the sensors to the body first, but the hint selected the eye and posture routes instead.

continue.text: I would probably continue if another chapter had a similarly concrete example. Seeing how the parts kept the eyes on a fixed point was more engaging than just joining the nerve routes.
